node.statement: Under the respective Stage-2 producer hypotheses, put t=t_2=W.K2*epsilon. Lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope applies with W.L>=L^0, W.K2>=max{K_2^0,1,W.L,W.c0_cb*W.L}, and W.e_s2<=e_s2^0, and, using lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum, furnishes the explicit closed Stage-2 EXT-CB datum in A_R with target ambient record epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=t and total post-helper defect at most C_s2^0*t. The producer smallness epsilon<=W.e_s2/W.K2 gives 0<=t<=W.e_s2, and W.e_s2<=min{e_s2^0,e_2} supplies the receiving condition required by lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension.
